title: PARTY EMERGENCIES NEVER WAIT
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, where a teammate going down is a callout that shows at once and stays while it is true. It was a sentence (NAME is down. Pick them up.) that went through the waiting queue and ran out after a few seconds while he was still on the floor. It is now TEAMMATE DOWN, a critical alert with a party glyph and NAME needs a revive. under it, shown on the next frame and held for as long as he is down, up to eight seconds; it goes once he is up. The host leaving (HOST IS OUT, with how his run ended) and taking over the raid (YOU ARE RUNNING THE RAID) are critical alerts too. The controller rumble stays and the party status window keeps its sentences.
now: TEAMMATE DOWN shows at once and holds while he is down; HOST IS OUT and YOU ARE RUNNING THE RAID are alerts too.

edits.anchor: try{ sayWhenFree((netSeatName(s)||'Your teammate')+' is down. Pick them up.','crit'); padRumble(0.55,420); }catch(_md){}
edits.replacement: try{ say('TEAMMATE DOWN','crit',{sub:(netSeatName(s)||'Your teammate')+' needs a revive.',key:'tmdown'+s,icon:'party',hold:(function(gg){ return function(){ return !!(gg&&gg.dn); }; })(g)}); padRumble(0.55,420); }catch(_md){}

try{ if(typeof G!=='undefined'&&G&&!G.over) say('HOST IS OUT','crit',{sub:(netSeatName(0)||'The host')+' '+((hw==='killed')?'was killed':hw?hw:'is out')+'. Extract to finish.',icon:'party'}); }catch(_sw){}   // v16.xx (R11): an alert, the name and how in the detail
try{ say('YOU ARE RUNNING THE RAID','crit',{sub:(why==='out')?'Your host is out.':'The connection to your host was lost.',icon:'party'}); }catch(_hs){}   // v16.xx (R11): an alert at once
